categories_thin: Independent retail (group D) in Fords is a short New Brunswick Ave / King Georges Rd strip: no independent furniture, bicycle, music or appliance dealer storefront surfaced beyond the few listed, and two of the three florists rest on one bulk directory each

Education: only dance schools, one music school, two driving schools and three child-care centres turned up; no tutoring centre or art school is based in the zone (the tutoring brands found serve it from other towns and are franchises)
Lodging: no independent inn or motel found in Fords, Hopelawn or Keasbey - the only hotel was the franchised property at 1050 King Georges Post Rd, which was removed under the chain rule
Self-storage, moving, pest control and tire categories are dominated by chains (Extra Space, Public Storage, Storage Rentals of America, Mavis) - only independents are listed
Keasbey is almost entirely industrial and distribution; Hopelawn is a small blue-collar neighbourhood whose eligible businesses are mostly trades, salons and one lumber yard
Group A professional offices are concentrated in two shared office buildings (720 King George Rd and 786 King George Rd) and most rest on a single Yellow Pages or carrier directory listing
caveats: Removed under the chain/franchise rule: the Best Western at 1050 King Georges Post Rd (franchise brand), Chris Andersen Roofing & Erecting of Hopelawn (its own company page now presents it as a Tecta America company), and the corporate branches Veseris, NFI Distribution, Alliance Shippers, Plastipak Packaging, Parlux Fragrances, simplehuman, US Beverage Packers/AriZona, Seville Classics, plus Hatco Corp, whose Fords identity could not be verified as the foodservice-equipment maker described earlier

Also removed as unconfirmed or excluded: Most Valuable Plumber (one unreviewed map pin, no independent trace), C & D Foods of Hopelawn (listing mixes food retail with equipment service), Fords Outdoor Power Equipment (map listing marked temporarily closed), Fords Mill Supply and Fords Mattress & Dinette (same street address as Fords Hardware, Mill Supply also sharing its phone), and probable former operators Bachrach School of Dance, Fords School House, C & A Auto Repair, P & J Auto Body and Garry's Precision Auto Tech

Entries whose active_evidence reads 'unverified - single bulk directory' come only from us-business.info, which renders without reviews and only partly (Fords shows letters A-I); they are carried as leads, not prospects, and need one independent confirmation (state licence, own site or map listing) before outreach

The zone brief named groups C and D; the verifier found the beauty/personal-care gap decisive, so group B salons, barbers, nail salons, spas and clinics are included, together with a small number of group A offices that are clearly independent and based in the zone
Google Maps listings often show a street address without a town; those towns were assigned from the map pin relative to the Fords/Hopelawn/Keasbey boundaries and are flagged in notes where inferred

Several Fords contractors share addresses (428, 440, 552 New Brunswick Ave; 341 Crows Mill Rd; 720 King George Rd is an office building with many suites) which look like shared, virtual or co-working addresses

Same-address pairs are flagged as possible rebrands of one shop (669 King Georges Rd; 834 King George Rd; 387 New Brunswick Ave; 526 New Brunswick Ave; 280 St Stephens Ave; 511 New Brunswick Ave; 39 Lafayette Rd; 201 New Brunswick Ave Hopelawn) - treat each pair as one prospect until confirmed

Chain and franchise locations seen and deliberately excluded: Mavis Discount Tire, JAN-PRO, Extra Space, Public Storage, Storage Rentals of America, The Home Depot, Lowe's, Harbor Freight, Walmart, Amazon, FedEx Ground, Wakefern, Republic Services, Skanska, Synnex, Haier America, Praxair, Union Carbide, Tilcon, Wabash National, Woodbridge Dodge, KeyMe, Minute Key, The UPS Store, Enterprise Rent-A-Car, Roto-Rooter, Sylvan Learning, Tutor Doctor, RE/MAX
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Cylex, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com and D&B return HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so their town-level category lists could only be read through search-result snippets rather than opened pages
The US Business Directory page for Fords renders only letters A-I, so its J-Z Fords entries could not be retrieved
OpenStreetMap Overpass API timed out - no OSM business dump or town polygons for the zone
Google Maps serves a limited result set per query, so very small home-based trades with weak map presence may be missing
Woodbridge Township publishes no online licensed-business directory for these neighbourhoods
Ozzy and Son Landscaping is filed under Carteret by one directory and 40 Howard St, Woodbridge Township 08861 by another; it is listed as Hopelawn on a zip-code inference only
Priority Sewer & Water's own site gives a Port Monmouth company address; the Fords address on its entry comes from a contractor directory, so membership in the zone is unconfirmed

No independent trace was found for Nu Image Hair Salon, Prime Time Cutz, Izycutz, Liberty Barbershop, The Made Man Barber Shop and Herb Clark Tree Service beyond a single listing each, and several of those listings mask the phone

Phones were not captured where the listing masked the number: Good Heart Cleaning, Red Trim Painting, Ruggiero Contractors, Auto-Rite Repairs, The Made Man Barber Shop, Liberty Barbershop, Prime Time Cutz, Izycutz, Nu Image Hair Salon, E-Z Wheels Driving School, United Distribution Service
